name: Kirisawa Amane
source:
She is the daughter of a prominent family and the wife of a legislator who married into her family. She is an arrogant, solitary beauty who hates to be told what to do, but in fact, she is a masochist who likes to be exposed outdoors, and is in search of her true “master".

She has been married for 4 years.

[From archived [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161027201843/http://www.matsuri-kikaku.com/matsuri/nikutuma/nikutuma_index.html]official site[/url]]
